About ME#I’m Brazilian, married, and the proud father of two plants, John and Daniel.
My first experience in software development was a part-time role back in 2016. Since then, every position I’ve held — whether full-time or part-time — has been in the tech field.
I hold a Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science from PUC Minas, Brazil, and a Master’s degree in Applied Computer Science from the Norwegian University of Science and Technology (NTNU) in Norway.
Outside of programming, I enjoy comedy shows like The Office and Curb Your Enthusiasm. I’m also a fan of classic horror B-movies such as The Evil Dead and Killer Klowns from Outer Space.
Here are some posts I’ve written:
title: About André Silva Gusmão

content:
Welcome to Capybasics.
Capybasics is a side project created by André Silva Gusmão that aims to teach software engineering and web development for everybody.
The idea is to cover the Basics, hence the name capyBASICS, of different topics related to software development. I will try to make blog posts and videos about the basics of the topics I aim to teach.
You might notice that the topics could have little to no link between them. This happens because since this is a side project I want to cover only topics that I find interesting at the moment I am studying them.
I also post videos about the topics in my youtube channel:
https://www.youtube.com/@Capybasics
